mercy_translation.text:
On the Lord's own day, gather together, break bread, and give thanks after confessing your transgressions, so that your sacrifice may be pure.

Let no one who has a dispute with his companion come together with you until they have been reconciled, so that your sacrifice may not be profaned.

For this is what was spoken by the Lord: In every place and at every time offer me a pure sacrifice, for I am a great King, says the Lord, and my name is wonderful among the nations.

translator_notes: Direct Mercy translation from the Greek public-domain source.
The chapter connects Sunday assembly, Eucharistic thanksgiving, confession, reconciliation, and pure sacrifice.
